ai_summary: A B Cotspin India Limited has notified shareholders without registered email addresses about its upcoming 29th Annual General Meeting on September 29, 2026, and provided the web-link to access the FY 2025-26 Annual Report, fulfilling SEBI regulatory requirements. A key takeaway is the critical reminder for shareholders holding physical securities to update their KYC details, as incomplete information will restrict all payments (e.g., dividends) to electronic mode only, a mandate effective since April 1, 2024. This serves as an important operational warning for affected shareholders to prevent payment disruptions.
